Load Pre-trained xG Model

Source: R/xg_model.R
load_xg_model.Rd

Loads xG model from saved RDS file or downloads from GitHub releases.

Usage

load_xg_model(path = NULL)

Arguments

path

Path to model RDS file. If NULL, attempts to download from releases.

Value

Fitted xG model
